senses.zh_definition: 待核实的字符串；现有材料不足以确定其马来语词义。西班牙语 cruz 可表示“十字形、十字架”，但该义不能直接作为马来语释义收录。
senses.en_definition: An unresolved token with no established Malay sense in the supplied evidence; Spanish cruz means a cross.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk yang belum dapat dikenal pasti maknanya dalam bahasa Melayu berdasarkan bahan yang diberikan; dalam bahasa Sepanyol, cruz bermaksud bentuk silang atau salib.
senses.nuances: noun 仅表示此处将字符串作为语言讨论对象，不是已确认的马来语词性。不能诚实地赋予 official 状态或声称有 DBP 正式释义，故标为 unverified。下列短语是编辑性示例，不是已验证的高频搭配。西班牙语释义依据 [RAE–ASALE：cruz](https://dle.rae.es/cruz)，不代表已确认输入词来自西班牙语。

etymology.historical_story: The Spanish dictionary of RAE and ASALE traces cruz to Latin crux, crucis and records meanings involving a cross. That documented history belongs to the Spanish word. The isolated token supplied here has no identifying context, so attaching that history to a Malay headword would exceed the evidence. Its intended identity remains unresolved. Source: [RAE–ASALE](https://dle.rae.es/cruz).
